name: porthole
description: Phone-first web console for a personal dev box: tmux-backed Claude Code shells, file browser with uploads, one-tap Cloudflare tunnels.

scripts.lint: cd .. && node server/node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js --no-config-lookup --rule "no-use-before-define: [error, { functions: false, classes: true, variables: false }]" --rule "no-undef: off" web/app.js server/server.js server/lib/*.js
